description.message: Control the volume of each Chrome tab with the physical sliders of deej-tab

cmdNext.message: Assign this tab to the next free number (press again to move on; the last press unassigns)

cmdSlot1.message: Assign this tab to Tab 1 (press again to unassign)

cmdSlot2.message: Assign this tab to Tab 2 (press again to unassign)

cmdSlot3.message: Assign this tab to Tab 3 (press again to unassign)

cmdSlot6.message: Assign this tab to Tab 6 (press again to unassign)
